## Rough Draft Oaks Project Analysis

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

## Loading packages

First, we will load the packages needed for this analysis.

```{r}
library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggpubr)
```

The `echo: false` option disables the printing of code (only output is displayed).

## Summary table

Next, we will load in our datasets:

```{r}
# The following code was written by Amy King-Henry:
Moist_Data_Raw <- 
  read_excel("Oak Data Entry MCRS Field Trip.xlsx", 
             sheet = "Soil Moisture")

Moist_Data_Raw

head(Moist_Data_Raw)

#Moist_Data_Clean <- Moist_Data_Raw |> 
#drop_na(Treatment)

# Natural recruits were found across all treatments, not relevant for the possible differences between microhabitats
Moist_Data_Clean <- Moist_Data_Raw |> 
  filter(Treatment != "NR")

# Making the date the same as data sets used later
Moist_Data_Clean$Date <- as.character(Moist_Data_Clean$Date)
head(Moist_Data_Clean)

Moist_Data_Clean <- Moist_Data_Clean |>
  mutate(VWC1_perc = as.numeric(VWC1_perc))

Moist_Data_Clean <- Moist_Data_Clean |>
  mutate(VWC2_perc = as.numeric(VWC2_perc))

Moist_Data_Clean <- Moist_Data_Clean |>
  mutate(VWC3_perc = as.numeric(VWC3_perc))

Moist_Data_Clean <- Moist_Data_Clean |> 
  group_by(Block, Treatment, VWC1_perc, VWC2_perc, VWC3_perc)|>
  mutate(VWC_avg = mean(c(VWC1_perc, VWC2_perc, VWC3_perc), na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  ungroup()

Moist_Data_Clean



# Preparing for ANOVA
Moist_Data_Merge <- Moist_Data_Clean |> 
  group_by(Block, Treatment)|>
  summarize(VWC_true_avg = mean(VWC_avg, na.rm = TRUE))

Moist_Data_Merge

#Regression_Data <- full_join(LICOR_Transpiration, Moist_Data_Merge)

#Regression_Data <- Regression_Data |> 
 # drop_na(VWC_true_avg)

#Regression_Data <- Regression_Data |> 
 # drop_na(Transpiration_avg)

#Regression_Data
```

## ANOVA

You can add options to executable code like this

```{r}
# We start by looking at how our data looks

ggplot(Moist_Data_Merge) +
  aes(x = Treatment, y = VWC_true_avg) + 
  geom_boxplot()

model  <- lm(VWC_true_avg ~ Treatment + Block, data = Moist_Data_Merge)

plot(model, which = 2)

# Create a QQ plot of residuals
ggpubr::ggqqplot(residuals(model))
```

The `echo: false` option disables the printing of code (only output is displayed).
